# Synthetic trade fixtures

`un_comtrade_tunisia_imports_world_2023_revised.json` is a **SYNTHETIC
REVISION TEST** derived from the committed real 2023 fixture. It is not real UN
Comtrade data and must never be used for production ingestion.

Its identifying dimensions and all other source fields are unchanged. Only
`primaryValue` is increased by the deterministic amount `1000.00`, from
`25930493874.99` to `25930494874.99`, solely to test revision/update behavior.
